newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock will be #3 in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock will be #3 in U.S..

text.p: The company to be formed by the proposed merger of Ultramar Corp and Diamond Shamrock Inc will be the third largest independent refiner and marketer in the U.S., Ultramar chief executive Jean Gaulin said Monday.
The two larger companies are Sun Co Inc and Tosco Corp, he told a telephone news conference.

To be called Ultramar Diamond Shamrock, the company will use the Diamond Shamrock brand in the U.S. southwest and the Ultramar brand in eastern Canada, Gaulin said. Convenience stores in both locations will be called "Cornerstore" -- the name Diamond Shamrock now uses for its convenience stores.
In Canada, fuel marketing equipment at the convenience stores will continue to carry the Ultramar brand, he said.
He also said "We don't intend to give up the Beacon brand," explaining the merged company will continue to use it on some service stations in California.

Racting to the free trade agreement which did away with tariffs on U.S.-Canadian transactions, the merged company plans to grow Ultramar's New England heating oil business to about 50,000 barrels per day from the current level of 15,000 barrels monthly. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
